phase: Issue #154 D2-D: local two-Target recomposition of existing Candidates (post-hoc analysis)

body.pairTable: §3.2 of the attested D2-D document (6 PAIRs, re-derived by §3.1 in V and compared)
derivationRule: F = D2C RESULT composition.main.finalAccepted (Target ID ascending, 8); finalResultEvaluationId = CMP-t10-c1, finalMetrics = { 23, 20, 1465 }; each G store = D2 sources.d2.generatedEntries (K0) / D2C discovery.targets[].pool[].generatedEntry (K1)
P07 = D2 RESULT discovery.targets[t07].pool (ordinal ascending, 3); D2 ADM-t07-c<o>.r1r4.R1 = true; F[t07] = P07[ordinal 1]
P05 = D2C RESULT discovery.targets[t05].pool (ordinal ascending, 2); D2C ADM-t05-c<o>.r1r4.R1 = true; D2C composition.main.steps[t05].stepOutcome = not_replaced_no_eligible
PAIRS = [(a, b) for a in P05 for b in P07] (t05 ordinal major, t07 ordinal minor) = PAIR ordinal 1 .. 6
PAIR replacement set = Fixed ∪ { t05: a, t07: b } (Target ID ascending, 9); I0 replacement set = F (8)
the derivation must equal the §3.2 table (set, order, Entry IDs, G store bytes / SHA-256, requiresSupport, inputDigest); any difference is input_evidence (no child starts)
i0Rule: I0 = the D2-C final accepted set (8, Target ID ascending), G bodies from the D2-B / D2-C G store, one fresh replacement_set run (the D2-C I0 procedure: Z0, no found_R)
requiresSupport: t00 / t10 [e396d352], t04 [92d87b90], others []; support records CTX-1 / CTX-5 / CTX-7
expected (d2c_final parity): inputDigest, evaluated, resultDigest, exhausted, 23 / 43, Conflict 20, steps 1465, R5 (D2-C CMP-t10-c1); the D2-C RESULT values are parity expectations only
I0 is the reference of the gate and of "better"; I0 unmeasured -> every PAIR not_executed (i0_unmeasured)
pairRule: for k in 1 .. 6 (PAIR ordinal order, each independent of the others): replacements = Fixed ∪ { t05: a, t07: b }, one replacement_set run
t05 is added (O_t05 -> a) and t07 is replaced (I0 t07 c1 -> b) in ONE PlannerInput; never two steps, never t07 alone
at most one generated Entry per Target in one PlannerInput (G15); the Fixed bodies and requiresSupport never change
every registered PAIR is evaluated (no early stop); PAIR selection uses the recorded results only, no extra run or composition
r5Definition: (3) every support Entry passes S1 - S3 (support_expired_R)
(4) no Conflict c with |c.buildListEntryIds ∩ M| >= 2, whatever c.selectedBuildListEntryId (conflict_within_set)
(5) status evaluated, plan !== null, termination.status in { completed, exhausted } (no_plan / plan_bound_truncated / preflight_refused / planner_rerun_bound_reached)
pairCoexistenceDefinition: t05.selected / t07.selected: the G of t05 / t07 is in plan.selectedBuildListEntryIds
winnerBuildListEntryId: the provisional winner of a non-selected G (route commitment, as the D1 candidates[])
targetSelected: the Target is in selectedTargetWeaponIds (recorded apart from selected, never corrected)
conflictsBetweenPair: Conflicts with both t05.G and t07.G as participants; conflictsWithPair: Conflicts with t05.G or t07.G and another member of M
pairCoexistence = t05.selected ∧ t07.selected ∧ conflictsBetweenPair = []  (diagnostic; the decision reads R5 only)
d2cT05ResourcesObserved: whether each D2-C CMP-t05-c1 / -c2 within-set Conflict resource identity appears in result.conflicts (any participants)
body.gate: completed(PAIR) >= completed(I0) (termination.completedTargetCount of the fresh I0); R5 without the gate is r5OnlyEligible (diagnostic); eligible = evaluated ∧ R5 ∧ gate
body.betterRule: completed larger, or completed equal and fewer Conflicts (steps are not compared)
body.improvedRule: improved = eligible ∧ (completed, conflicts) better than I0; equal completed and Conflict >= I0 is not improved (equalMetrics / conflictIncreased recorded)
r6Definition: (1) status evaluated, plan !== null, Trace Replay completed
(4) no plan.rejectedBuildListEntries element with reason resource_conflict
rvChecks: RV1 body: SHA-256, id, targetWeaponId, calculationContext, isStale = false, candidateSnapshot.searchRunId = the registered Search identity, SHA-256(candidateStableKey) = the registered keySha256
RV2 replacement: resolveBuildListEntryReplacement(baseline, G) ready with replacedBuildListEntryId = O_t

RV3 the Search-time reservation: K0 phase2c27bResolveSupportContext(baseline, t, []) (the D2-B path, with the schedule K0 context) hashing to the registered K0 digest; K1 the CTX record reservationBody (object) with pool reservationDigest = CTX reservationDigest and pool contextRecordSha256 = CTX record SHA-256
RV4 R0: respectsPhase2C2Reservation(summarizePhase2C2Entry(G, baseline), G route, res(G)).respects
RV5 S4: exactly one Export body of s and SHA-256(stableStringify(body)) = CTX supportBodySha256 (every CTX record of s)

RV6 S5: hashStableValue(derivePlannerAlternativeReservation([Export body of s])) = CTX reservationDigest AND stableStringify(derived) = stableStringify(CTX reservationBody) (both objects; every CTX record of s)
RV runs no Search, no full run, no discovery / materialization; any RV1 .. RV6 failure is a guardrail violation (the run aborts)
supportChecks: S1 dynamic: the support Target is not in the replacement set T
S2 dynamic: the support Entry is in the final run input (after the runtime-unsupported retries)
S3 dynamic: the support Entry is a valid Entry of the final run input initial context
S4 static: the support Entry in the evaluation input is the Export body and SHA-256(stableStringify(body)) = the CTX record supportBodySha256

S5 static: hashStableValue(derivePlannerAlternativeReservation([Export body])) = the CTX record reservationDigest AND stableStringify(derived) = stableStringify(CTX record reservationBody) (both objects)
decisionRule: D2D_INVALID: any formal validity violation (§6 / §8 / §9): input_evidence / provenance / baseline_parity_mismatch / d2c_parity / guardrail / determinism / evidence_integrity / raw_result_mismatch
D2D_INCOMPLETE: invalid 0 and a registered RV / B0 / I0 / PAIR is unmeasured or not_executed (a parity not_checked included); measured evidence is a lower bound
D2D_GLOBAL_COMPLETE_R: invalid 0, unmeasured 0, a PAIR satisfies R6
D2D_EXCEEDS_D2C_FINAL: otherwise, at least one improved PAIR
D2D_SET_COEXISTENT_NOT_BETTER: otherwise, at least one PAIR with R5 satisfied
D2D_NO_SET_COEXISTENCE: invalid 0, unmeasured 0, all 6 PAIRs measured with R5 not satisfied
d2cResultFieldsRead: evaluations[evaluationId in {B0,CMP-t10-c1,CMP-t05-c1,CMP-t05-c2,ADM-t05-c1,ADM-t05-c2}].{evaluationId,stage,status,inputDigest,resultDigest,generatedEntryIds,generatedEntrySha256s,plan.{termination,steps},conflicts (count; CMP-t05: kind / participants / resourceIdentity / selectedBuildListEntryId),candidates[].{label,selected,winnerBuildListEntryId},r5.{satisfied,failureReasons},r1r4.R1}
d2ResultFieldsRead: sources.{export,d2.generatedEntries[file = the 7 D2-B G store files]}

d2cResultFieldsRead: evaluations[evaluationId in {B0,CMP-t10-c1,CMP-t05-c1,CMP-t05-c2,ADM-t05-c1,ADM-t05-c2}].{evaluationId,stage,status,inputDigest,resultDigest,generatedEntryIds,generatedEntrySha256s,plan.{termination,steps},conflicts (count; CMP-t05: kind / participants / resourceIdentity / selectedBuildListEntryId),candidates[].{label,selected,winnerBuildListEntryId},r5.{satisfied,failureReasons},r1r4.R1}
d2ResultFieldsRead: sources.{export,d2.generatedEntries[file = the 7 D2-B G store files]}

conditions.runnerStage: B0 runs runD2CEvaluation() stage B0 (persisted); I0 and PAIR run the D2-C I0 procedure (stage Z0 of runD2Evaluation(): replacement_set, no found_R); the RESULT records the stage as B0 / I0 / PAIR
conditions.supportContextRule: each K1 replacement carries its own CTX record (t00 CTX-1, t04 CTX-5, t05 CTX-6, t10 CTX-7) to runD2CEvaluation(); the analyzer judges S4 / S5 against the lowest-k CTX record of the support (e396d352: CTX-1), which RV / V prove equal to every other CTX record of the same support
conditions.equalMetricsRule: equalMetrics / conflictIncreased are recorded for eligible PAIRs only (they explain why an eligible PAIR is not improved); false otherwise
conditions.priorDeterminismScope: the allowlisted D2 (B0, ADM-t07-c1..c3) and D2-C (B0, CMP-t10-c1, CMP-t05-c1/-c2, ADM-t05-c1/-c2) evaluations; §1.8 registers that no PAIR inputDigest occurs among all 86 + 26 prior evaluations
conditions.runtimeUnsupportedRemovalDerivation: the rng_prediction_unsupported warnings of the result that the validation of the run input does not produce, one per retry (fail closed otherwise)
